newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Oct manufacturers' shipments fall 2.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Oct manufacturers' shipments fall 2.6 pct.

text.p: Canadian manufacturers' shipments fell 2.6 percent in October, to C$33.24 billion seasonally adjusted from a revised C$34.14 (C$34.29) billion in September, Statistics Canada said on Monday.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast shipments to fall 3.3 percent, unfilled orders to rise 2.7 percent, new orders to fall 2.1 percent and an inventory/shipment ratio of 1.32.
Statistics Canada said the decline in the total manufacturing shipments was caused by a three-week strike at General Motors Corp's Canadian unit in October.
"The result can be viewed as a temporary setback for auto manufacturers, since the strike was settled before the beginning of November," the agency said.
Excluding the impact of the strike, shipments rose 1.6 percent in the month.
Inventories increased for the third month in a row, while unfilled orders remained little changed.
